name: ripcord-video
description: The Ripcord demo video, composed in code from a real capture of the live page (docs/VIDEO.md).

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Ripcord out/ripcord.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --browser-executable "$REMOTION_BROWSER"
scripts.master: ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/ripcord.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/ripcord-final.mp4
